register: # ADDRESS SHIFT: the register column holds the Modbus PDU (wire) address, which is the vendor's printed register number minus 1 (SunSpec and Fronius number registers from 1, so the SunSpec marker 'SunS' is register 40001 and is read at address 40000). The rows in this file were shifted by -1 for that reason. To compare a row with the vendor document, add 1 to its register (for example Fronius lists total AC power as 40092 and it is read at 40091).

# CORRECTED, NOT JUST SHIFTED: the float inverter model has four temperature floats (cabinet, heat sink, transformer, other) but the original map defined one, so operating_state, vendor_state, alarm_1 and alarm_2 were 6 registers too low. They now use the SunSpec model 113 positions (St 40117, StVnd 40118, Evt1 40119, Evt2 40121). options, version and serial_number were also corrected to the SunSpec common-model fields Opt (40036), Vr (40044) and SN (40052): the original had them rotated by one field. These corrections come from the SunSpec standard, not from Fronius documentation.

# SCALING: the float models need no scale factors; the two nameplate ratings (rated_power, rated_va) are integers with a scale factor and now carry a Context adjustment that reads it (10**SF), so they publish in W and VA. Writable rows are not scaled.

# DYNAMIC MAP: rows whose register column is [anchor+offset] are template rows. The anchors come from the SunSpec model chain the device reports (discovery in the protocol JSON) and fall back to the discovery_defaults in that JSON, which reproduce the fixed layout this file used before, so nothing changes until a device reports something different. Float inverter rows are anchored on inverter_float_1_base (SunSpec models 111-113), the integer+scale-factor variant on inverter_1_base (models 101-103), so switching the inverter's model type (register 216 in the vendor document) is followed automatically. Nameplate (120) and basic settings (121) are anchored on their models. The storage rows at 40357 and above, the Fronius-specific registers (211-216) and the site totals (499-509) are not anchored and stay at fixed addresses. See documentation/architecture/dynamic_register_discovery.md.

register: # Fronius Primo / Galvo / Symo / Symo GEN24 / Symo Hybrid / ECO / AGILO
# Interface: Modbus TCP port 502; unit ID 1 (default; configurable)
# Also Modbus RTU RS485 on COM port (Datamanager 2.0 / 3.0 box); 9600 baud 8N1
# Enable Modbus: Inverter web UI → Communication → Modbus → Enable TCP/IP
# Protocol: SunSpec — two model types selectable via register 216 in the vendor document (address 215):
#   1 = Float (model IDs 111/112/113): all values are float32; no scale factors needed
# This file covers the FLOAT model (111=single-phase -- 112=split-phase -- 113=three-phase)
# All float32 values span two consecutive 16-bit registers; big-endian
# NaN = 0x7FC00000 (float) indicates not applicable for current model/phase
# Fronius-specific registers (F_ prefix) start at register 212 in the vendor document, which is address 211 here
# SunSpec Common Model Block: addresses 40000-40068 (vendor registers 40001-40069)
